enabled.description: Enable the parprouted service to start automatically at boot.

interfaces.description: List of interface pairs to bridge. Each item specifies an input interface and an output interface (both must exist and be up).

in_if.description: Input interface (e.g., eth0). This interface receives IP packets for proxy ARP.

out_if.description: Output interface (e.g., br0). This interface forwards ARP/ICMP responses.

pidfile.description: Absolute path to the PID file used by the daemon to record its process ID.

options.description: Extra command-line arguments to pass to the parprouted binary (e.g., '-n 300' for timeout).
